title: Solar System Cut & Paste Activity

overview.description: Solar system cut-and-paste activity. Child cuts out planet images/labels, pastes them in correct order or position on a diagram. Fourth solar system drop from Aless. The cut-and-paste format adds a tactile/kinesthetic dimension to the solar system study — the child physically places planets in order, which is more engaging and memorable than circling or writing.

cutAndPaste.description: Child cuts out pieces and glues them in the correct position. Combines: scissor skills (fine motor) + sequencing/ordering (cognitive) + spatial placement (visual-spatial). The physical act of placing a planet between Mars and Saturn reinforces its position more than reading about it.
cutAndPaste.value: Multi-sensory learning. Cutting + reading + deciding + placing = four engagement channels.
